claim: Waanders In de Broeren (now Van der Velde Boeken) is a bookstore inside the 15th-century Broerenkerk in Zwolle, built by Dominican monks from 1466 to 1512; BK Architecten added three floors in 2013 without altering the original structure, preserving 139 ceiling paintings and the original Scheuer organ.
quote: 139 paintings from the early 1500s, showing saints, scenes from Christ's life, local coats of arms, and floral motifs... Architects at BK. Architecten added three floors while avoiding alterations to the original structure

claim: The bookshop in the Broeren church now operates under the Van der Velde Boeken name and is listed by VisitZwolle as the city's signature bookstore experience, with a brasserie, tourist information point and cultural events inside.
quote: Van der Velde in de Broeren

claim: Northern Dutch chain Van der Velde took over Waanders in de Broeren; Wim Waanders retired and daughter Ellen Waanders stayed on, with all jobs retained and Van der Velde now operating nine locations across Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe and Overijssel.
quote: Van der Velde koopt Waanders in de Broeren (Zwolle)

claim: Zwolle's Saturday market in the city centre runs 08:30–17:00, the Friday downtown market (including an organic section) runs 09:00–18:00, and smaller weekday markets cover Tuesday (AA-landen), Wednesday (Zwolle South), and Thursday (Stadshagen).
quote: Saturday — Location: Center of Zwolle — Hours: 8:30 am - 5:00 pm

claim: The Saturday market on Melkmarkt and Grote Markt hosts around 60 merchants selling fresh produce, baked goods and local delicacies in a pedestrianised zone.
quote: About 60 merchants at the Saturday market

claim: Zwolse balletjes — a hard candy made since 1845 by founder J. van der Kolk — are produced and sold only at Het Zwolse Balletjeshuis on Grote Kerkplein 13, where they're packaged in old-fashioned cones and modern tins.
quote: The unique and authentic candy since 1845

claim: Zwolse balletjes are recognised on the Dutch Inventory of Intangible Cultural Heritage, made by hand in the Balletjeshuis on Grote Kerkplein in Zwolle.

Diezerstraat is Zwolle's main high-street with chains like H&M, Zara, Douglas and Søstrene Grene; Sassenstraat (top-10 nicest shopping streets in the Netherlands) and Luttekestraat hold the unique boutiques and vintage shops, and Het Eiland is home to Van der Velde in de Broeren.
quote: Sassenstraat — Ranked in the top 10 most enjoyable shopping streets in the Netherlands

claim: Notable indie boutiques include Spøtted, Sassy and Villa Mooi on Sassenstraat (Scandinavian-inspired and fair-wear womenswear), Moonloft (home and jewellery), Bagheera (jewellery, Roggestraat), Millows (gifts) and Engel Winkelcafé (fair-trade café-boutique).
quote: Villa Mooi (Sassenstraat) — Specializes in fair-wear women's clothing that is produced responsibly and sustainably

claim: Bijzonderheden on Papenstraat, opposite Museum de Fundatie, is a concept store selling handmade textile pouches by Marion and silver jewellery by goldsmith Rian alongside original gifts.
Zwolle has four dedicated record shops including Variaworld (heart of the centre) and Diskid Interrecords, both stocking new and secondhand vinyl across genres.
quote: We have 4 record stores in Zwolle

claim: Diskid Interrecords is a long-running Zwolle vinyl shop with a deep secondhand collection across rock, jazz, soul and electronic music.
